newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Families of two British nurses jailed in Saudi Arabia will visit them soon. The families are now in Riyadh.
- Saudi Arabia wants more German investments.
- Saudi Arabian investors urged to invest in Malaysia.
- Saudi Crown Prince Abdullah to lead the kingdom's delegation to the Islamic summit opening in Pakistan on Sunday.
- Saudi businessmen seek to invest in water desalination plants.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines carried 45,000 passengers to the United States in 1996.
- AL-Ahsa Development Company posts 12.9 million riyal net profit in 1996.
